punchline: Same film of the game: Princeton fans counted 9.8 Dartmouth fouls, Dartmouth fans counted 4.3.
thirty_sec: After a rough 1951 Princeton-Dartmouth game, Hastorf and Cantril showed students of both schools the same film: Princeton viewers counted an average of 9.8 Dartmouth infractions, Dartmouth viewers 4.3, and each campus blamed the other.
question: In your most recent disagreement, which moment did the other person count that you never noticed?
key_contrast: One game on film, two games in the minds of the viewers.
